Report mandates (16 report mandates)

Statutory duties that require this agency to publish or file a report, with a City Record filing receipt when that report appears.

  • ◆Mandate · Submit an estimate of the assessed valuation of real property and a certified statement of all real property taxes due.
    report · deadline 2015-03-12 · one-time · § 1(8) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the Council on outreach sessions performed during the ninety-day period preceding the tax-lien sale, including specified session results disaggregated by council district.
    report · deadline 2015-05-06 · one-time · § 5, subdivision j · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the Council a report on outreach sessions and disaggregate the report and results by council district.
    report · deadline 2017-04-27 · one-time · § 10; Administrative Code § 11-320(j) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Issue a report on deferral agreements established pursuant to the local law, submit it to the Council Speaker, publish it on the department’s website, and include specified borough-disaggregated information.
    report · deadline 2020-11-01 · one-time · Section 1(j) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Issue a report on deferral agreements, submit it to the speaker of the council, and publish it on the department's website, including specified information disaggregated by borough.
    report · deadline 2020-11-01 · one-time · Section 1(k) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the Council on specified outstanding debt and related notices of violations.
    report · deadline: No later than May first of each year · annual · Administrative Code § 11-136(1) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · The department must submit an annual report to the council indicating the number and nature of written or verbal inquiries received by the ombudsperson and recommendations made by the ombudsperson regarding program administration, disaggregated by Council District.
    report · deadline: No later than October first of each year · annual · §11-136(1)(c) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Report to the speaker of the council and to the mayor a plan and timeline for revocation of benefits under section 421-a of the real property tax law.
    report · deadline: Within 60 days after receiving a report from the department of housing preservation and development pursuant to section 26-1203 of the code · one-time · Administrative Code § 11-139 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report to the speaker of the council and make it publicly available online, reporting on the commercial rent tax and including the specified information for the prior tax year.
    report · deadline: No later than October first, two thousand seventeen, and every October first thereafter · annual · Administrative Code § 11-719(a) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit an annual report to the Council concerning tax lien sales and include the specified information.
    report · deadline: Concerning the sale or sales of tax liens during the preceding year · annual · § 13; Administrative Code § 11-355 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Provide the Council a report listing properties on which liens were sold during the specified period and indicating recorded transfers or mortgages.
    report · deadline: No later than October 31, 2020 · one-time · § 13; Administrative Code § 11-355 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit to the Council a list of all properties noticed for sale, identified by block and lot, including a description of the disposition of those properties.
    report · deadline: No later than one hundred twenty days after the tax lien sale · one-time · Administrative Code § 11-320(g) · Source law↗

Sources and measure definitions

  • IBO New York City Fiscal History: actual department expenditures in publisher $000s, shown here in USD; staffing is actual full-time positions reported as of June 30. Publisher vintage FY2022.
  • PASSPort Public procurement records: registered contract values and counts are a point-in-time snapshot of current registered value, not actual spending.
  • Checkbook NYC, the Comptroller's spending ledger: actual payment amounts and transaction counts, not registered contract values.

These sources use different accounting scopes.
